name: X-LAB RS7
why_interesting: X-LAB's international carbon road bike: US$2,099 with Shimano 105, a power-meter crankset and Branta carbon wheels, an official 32C maximum tire clearance and 8.49 kg in size L. The official mainland store did not list it on 2026-10-27.
missing: Mainland China availability, price and seller route
Reconciled frame carbon grade (international page: Toray T800; Australian page: T700)
Full 105 Di2 build specification and US price
Independent complete-bike weight and frame-stiffness evidence
price_status: official US list price converted as a CNY reference

official_price.price_basis: Official international RS7 105 mechanical build at US$2,099, converted at the ECB reference cross-rate of 1 October 2026.
official_price.conditions: Foreign reference only; the US offer includes shipping in the contiguous U.S. Mainland availability and price, import duty, tax and the actual transaction rate are unknown.

source_note: The catalog row uses the international 105 mechanical build. The Australian distributor's 105 Di2 page and a 2024 China-market owner report stay separate below. The two official regional pages disagree on frame carbon grade and fitted tires; both state 8.49 kg and a 32C maximum clearance.

facts.complete_weight_basis: Official international size-L complete-bike weight for the 105 mechanical build.
facts.frame: XDS carbon frame; international page: Toray T800 frame and Toray T-700 fork
facts.frame_material: International page: Toray T800 frame and T-700 fork; the Australian distributor page instead lists an XDS T700 carbon frame
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer maximum tire clearance (international specification and Australian FAQ).
facts.wheels: Branta C45 Base carbon, stainless spokes
facts.tires: Branta R301 30C (international page); the Australian Di2 page lists Branta R332 700×32C
facts.crankset: Branta alloy power-meter crankset, 52/36T, 24 mm steel spindle; dual-sided measurement per the Australian FAQ
facts.mounts: Not designed for fenders or racks (Australian FAQ)
facts.max_load: 110 kg including rider and gear (Australian FAQ)
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL and XXL
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 526/360, S 535/370, M 546/380, L 561/390, XL 574/400, XXL 602/412

alternative_builds.label: Australian distributor RS7 105 Di2
alternative_builds.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 (product title; the page's component table lists mechanical 105 parts)
alternative_builds.notes: AUD 3,999 RRP on 2026-10-27; online ordering not yet available. The page lists an XDS T700 carbon frame, which conflicts with the international T800 statement.

alternative_builds.label: 2024 China-market XDS RS7 105 Di2 (owner report)
alternative_builds.wheels: Novatec R5 as delivered, later replaced by the owner
alternative_builds.notes: One owner reports more than 10,000 km without a dropped chain or shifting fault. Whether this 2024 RS7 shares the current X-LAB RS7 frame is not established.
